title: Isolated browser profile with typed provider contract and origin binding
objective: Establish the first COTRA-P08 structured-browser foundation on top of the SG-000018 replay-resistant foundation, SG-000019 STRONG enforcement, and SG-000020 trust and revoke records: a dedicated isolated Cotra automation browser profile with a typed provider contract and strict origin binding, so destination policy, SSRF defenses, and redirect-widening denial are proven before any navigation or DOM actuation authority is introduced.

include: dedicated isolated Cotra automation browser profile with fresh storage and no personal cookies, credentials, passwords, or sessions by default
typed browser provider contract with capability and operation shapes for profile status and origin-bound destination validation
origin binding with scheme, host, and port validation, DNS re-resolution, and destination policy applied after resolution
SSRF defenses denying loopback, link-local, and private ranges unless an explicitly trusted workspace destination allows them
redirect-widening denial so a validated destination cannot silently widen to a broader authority
explicit denial of all browser actuation shapes including navigation, snapshot actuation, DOM writes, downloads, and uploads
deterministic unit and security tests for profile isolation, origin binding, SSRF denial, redirect denial, actuation denial, replay and drift retention, and separation
retention of all SG-000018 one-shot, expiry, digest, history, SG-000019 STRONG enforcement, and SG-000020 trust and revoke behavior with no change outside browser destination policy
exclude: DOM or accessibility-tree actuation of any kind
screenshots and visual or coordinate control
stored credential, cookie, or password access
arbitrary DevTools, CDP commands, or browser scripting
network egress beyond local destination validation
approval delegation to remote or MCP callers

authority_delta.filesystem: An isolated automation profile directory is created under Cotra protected local state; personal browser data, workspace files, Git state, and unrelated paths gain no new readability or writability.
authority_delta.process: No new process authority. No browser is launched or attached in this grain; the provider contract is local policy only.
authority_delta.network: None. Destination validation is strictly local with no egress; no fetch, socket, or tunnel authority is added.
authority_delta.browser: Profile isolation and destination policy only. Navigation, snapshot actuation, DOM writes, downloads, uploads, personal-profile access, and debugging authority remain absent.
authority_delta.ui_input: None. No input injection or UI automation is added.
authority_delta.secrets: No cookie, credential, or password material enters prompts, records, history, logs, MCP responses, or evidence packets.
authority_delta.approval: Future browser actuation shapes are explicitly denied and require fresh approval design in a successor grain. No persistent reuse or remote delegation is introduced.

invariants: The automation profile is isolated and carries no personal browser data, credentials, or sessions
Every browser destination binds exact scheme, host, and port with DNS re-resolution and post-resolution policy
Loopback, link-local, and private destinations fail closed unless explicitly trusted by workspace policy
A validated destination never silently widens through redirects
All browser actuation shapes fail closed as denied in this grain
The agent cannot reach browser capability through MCP tools, synthetic input, UI automation, coordinates, or child processes
STRONG enforcement, one-shot, expiry, digest, workspace, and policy bindings are not weakened
No actuation, personal-profile, debugging, credential, network-egress, reuse, delegation, or elevation authority is introduced

acceptance.claim: Tests prove the automation profile is created isolated with fresh storage and that personal browser data, cookies, credentials, and sessions are unreachable.
Tests prove destination validation binds scheme, host, and port with re-resolution and denies loopback, link-local, and private targets outside explicit trust.
Tests prove redirect widening beyond the validated destination fails closed.
Tests prove navigation, snapshot actuation, DOM writes, downloads, and uploads fail closed as denied capability shapes.
Tests prove the agent cannot satisfy browser capability through MCP tools, synthetic input, UI automation, coordinate proposals, child processes, or replayed prior approvals.
Tests prove replay, expiry, digest mismatch, revision drift, and double-consumption protections remain enforced for both classes.
Tests prove all P06 approval flows and SG-000018/019/020 regressions still pass with digests unchanged outside browser labeling.
Tests prove personal-profile mode, arbitrary DevTools or CDP, browser scripting, credential stores, and network egress remain unreachable.

Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, manual review of excluded security-sensitive files, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p08_navigation: Navigation, DOM and accessibility-tree operations, and scoped downloads and uploads remain successor work and must build on the isolated profile and origin binding without weakening STRONG enforcement, one-shot, expiry, or digest binding.
successor_requirements.p08_exit: COTRA-P08 exits when structured browser operations are proven with SSRF tests, redirect-widening tests, and the personal profile disabled by default, which this grain plus its successors must jointly satisfy.

done_when: Isolated automation browser profile with typed provider contract and origin binding is merged with SSRF and redirect-widening denial, actuation denial, agent-forgery tests, retained replay and drift enforcement, and no new actuation, personal-profile, debugging, credential, or network-egress authority.
